title: Tanium Product Management
summary: This note covers the owner's interest in cybersecurity and Tanium, stemming from a personal experience with a canceled flight and subsequent curiosity about system failures. It also outlines questions the owner has about Tanium's culture, product modules, strategic direction, and technical architectures.

key_points.text: Managed a $47M portfolio across 50+ large projects
Core PM skills: defining the problem, validating the solution, making trade-offs, and ensure delivery to your customers in a timely manner
Interest in cybersecurity started with a canceled flight due to a CrowdStrike outage
Tanium kept appearing in comparisons after comparing different companies in the space
Interested in understanding technical and operational failures that led to the catastrophe
Questions about user feedback collection at Tanium
Questions about strategic direction: AI space, cybersecurity space competing with CrowdStrike, or a third direction
